text: # FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
## Academic Bureau and General Inquiries

### Can I meet representative from Academic Bureau to consult matters regarding my studies?

In-person consultation with our representative will only be conducted upon prior appointment. Student(s) or guardian(s) who wish to make such consultation may come on the agreed schedule.

### Who to contact for more information regarding financial matters?

Information regarding tuition fee, installment, late payment, financial assistance, extend fee, defense fee, graduation fee, and all the other types of financial matters fall under the authority of Finance and Accounting Bureau. Students are encouraged to contact the aforesaid bureau.

### What if I missed the deadline for enrollment?

Please ensure that you do not have any outstanding payment then try to re-enroll independently in 1x24 hours on working days after the payment. If it still does not work, you may seek assistance to the Academic Bureau. You might also experience some difficulties accessing your e-campus as the related Bureau needs extra time to synchronize your access if you missed your enrollment deadline.

### Why do I need to ensure my identity and contact information on PUIS are accurate and up to date?

We use your personal identity and contact information stored on PUIS for many purposes, starting from disseminating crucial announcements (warning letter(s), student status information, etc), submitting report to the official government body, issuing official diploma and transcript, and many more. Your cooperation to carefully fill in your biodata on PUIS is greatly expected for your own advantage.

### Why can't I access my GPA?

If you experience this issue, you probably:

1. Have incomplete admission document requirement(s);
2. Have outstanding payment; and/or
3. Have not filled out lecturing evaluation.
## Course Enrollment and Academic Records

### I have requested a conversion for my retake subject, why does the old subject/grade still appear on my PUIS?

The process for this should be called "hide subject/grade". If you have retaken any failed subject/grade and requested to hide this particular subject/grade on PUIS, please be informed that if you have received a confirmation email regarding this matter, it means that your failed subject/grade will not appear on your transcript and will be disregarded from the overall GPA calculation. It will still, however, appear only on the GPA menu on your PUIS as it serves as a record of your whole studies in President University.

### Why can't I access my daily class schedule?

Your access to daily class schedule is restricted temporarily until you fulfill the minimum meeting requirement with your Academic Advisor.

### Why can't I enroll on the scheduled enrollment period?

Your access to enrollment is blocked if you have not conducted a consultation session with your Academic Advisor beforehand.

### What should I do if I get warning letter(s)?

We are suggesting the student(s) receiving such letter(s) to take academic leave instead (if you're still able to) to restart the amount of warning letter(s) that have been sent. We will proceed to disseminate warning letter(s) to non-active student(s) who do not take academic leave until eventually you get dropped out (1 month after receiving the 3rd warning letter).

### Can I drop the subject(s) or class(es) that I have been enrolled in?

No.

### Can I change my concentration?

No.

### What if I lost my diploma?

President University will only issue a Replacement Letter as the substitute of the lost diploma/transcript that will serve as legally as the original diploma/transcript. Alumni requesting for this document should also attach a statement letter of lost diploma/transcript issued by the Indonesian police office.
## Digital Diploma and Transcript

### Why can't I access my digital diploma and transcript?

If you experience this issue, you probably have not completed all the requirements regarding digital photo(s), clearance, payment, or failure to meet the deadline for uploading digital photos, etc. Failure to meet one requirement will result in the restricted access to download the digital diploma and transcript.

### What if I don't submit digital photos for diploma and transcript in accordance with the set deadline?

We are using a system provided by third party for issuing these digital documents. This process certainly cannot be done as easily and as quickly. We are afraid that you will not be able to claim your digital diploma and transcript if you fail to meet the set deadline as there are procedures and schedules that we are also following.

### Who to contact regarding degree verification?

Request for degree verification can be made via email to Academic Bureau.

### Why haven't I been cleared for judicium?

Judicium clearance requires verification from various aspects such as the completion of credits taken, subjects validity, minimum score that can be tolerated by each study program, etc. If you have not been cleared for judicium, it is highly possible that we are still coordinating the said essential aspects to the relevant departments.
## Transfer and Major Changes

### What if I want to transfer to President University?

Prospective students who wish to transfer from other institutions or further their studies (from D3/D4) in President University are welcome anytime. We strongly advise you to contact our Admission Bureau for further information regarding the program we have in President University. You may start your academic year by enrolling in the scheduled enrollment period.

### Can I change my major?

Only after you finish 1 academic year. However, please bear in mind that not all subjects you have taken can be converted. This might result in the extension of your graduation time. Changing your major will affect your status as a transfer student in President University. Thus, you will not be eligible for distinguish graduation predicate (cum laude, magna cum laude, and summa cum laude).
## Photo Requirements for Diploma and Transcript

### Why do I need to ensure the photos submitted for both physical and digital diploma and transcript is in accordance with the requirements?

The photos you submit for this matter will stick on your diploma and transcript for the rest of your life. We set the relatively best requirements for these photos so that you have the chance to impress your prospective recruiter by showing a proper look when applying to companies/universities using this diploma and transcript. We are also trying to avoid ruining your photos while attaching it on your physical diploma and transcript. Hence the specific type of paper required for the physical photos.
## Communication Guidelines

### What to say when contacting the relevant bureau(s)/department(s)?

Always state your full name, student ID number, and your question(s)/request(s) /problem(s). In the event that communication is made via email, kindly put the summary of your queries properly on the subject email. Kindly write the message in proper English so that we can understand the message better.

### When is the appropriate time to contact Academic Bureau?

We are open for online services from Monday to Friday at 09:00 – 16:00 for other specific Academic matters. We will not respond to matters that have been explained herein. Students are encouraged to read this guideline thoroughly to obtain the necessary information.

### Does Academic Bureau also provide offline services during the said time?

As almost everything is provided on the system, we are now limiting offline services. For the time being, we only provide in person consultation upon prior appointment (for classified matters) and offline services for diploma and transcript legalization.
# GENERAL INFORMATION

## "Why Choose President University?"

President University is Indonesia’s premier university with the highest enrolment of full-time international students. Below are the more reasons to choose President University:

### a. English-Speaking University
The implementation of this benefit is ensured through the use of English as medium of instruction in all lectures carried out daily in President University. Students who might experience difficulties in carrying out this obligation are supported by the implementation of free English courses offered to all students for 6 semesters.

### b. International Environment
One of the reasons of its strong international environment is affected by the fact that President University is considered as the premier university in Indonesia with the highest enrolment of full-time international students. That said, local students have the opportunity to share classes and also connect with international students through various student organizations and events.

### c. Save Time
With the applicable curriculum, undergraduate students have the opportunity to finish their studies in just over 3 years.

### e. Value for Money
Taking into account the wide-range of scholarships offered in President University, access to higher education is possible for all prospective students who wish to further their studies.

## About PUIS
The President University Information System (PUIS) plays an important role in managing the daily operations of President University. It is not only the university’s main database and information hub, but it also supports daily activities by providing services that all Civitas Academica can access from anywhere with an internet connection.

Because of its importance, all members of the university, especially students are encouraged to regularly check and update their personal information on PUIS, such as email address, home address, and phone number. This helps prevent any missed information or announcements.

If you experience any issues accessing your PUIS account, please contact the Software Development Bureau at pu-softdev@president.ac.id.

## Academic Advisor (Role and Responsibilities)
An Academic Advisor is a faculty member who helps guide students throughout their academic journey. Students are required to consult with their Academic Advisor at least once before each semester’s enrollment period. This consultation ensures you’re on track with your courses, degree requirements, and academic goals.

Additionally, every time you enroll in courses, your course selection must be validated by your Academic Advisor. This step ensures your choices align with your academic plan and program requirements. Your advisor is also there to assist with academic challenges, and help you make informed decisions for success throughout your time at the university.

## Academic Minor
Academic Minor is a learning program that may be taken by students from outside of their initial study program. Students planning to take this Academic Minor should report to the Head and Dean of their initial Study Program and Faculty. Additionally, students are also required to take all of the subjects determined to be the Minor subjects. These are required, so they can obtain the Academic Minor Degree acknowledgement.

The minimum credits to obtain the said degree acknowledgement may vary from one Study Program to another. This depends on what’s regulated under the Dean’s Decree.
##Graduation Requirements: Credits and GPA

### Undergraduate Programs (Regular and Executive)
* Minimum credits to graduate: 144;
* Minimum Grade Point Average (GPA) to graduate: 2.00; and
* Study period: 3.5 to 7 years maximum.

### Graduate Programs
* Minimum credits to graduate: 36;
* Minimum GPA to graduate: 3.00; and
* Study period: 1 to 4 years maximum.

> **Note:** Even though the credits in the prevailing curriculum may be different from the credits assigned to the subjects you took initially, the credits cannot be adjusted to the ones assigned in the new curriculum unless the students are re-taking these subjects in question.

### GPA Classification

**GPA Grading Scale and Score Requirements:**

The following shows the relationship between numerical scores, letter grades, and GPA points on a 4.00 scale:

| Score Range | Letter Grade | GPA Points (4.00 Scale) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Score 85 or above | A | 4.00 |
| Score 80 to 84 | A- | 3.67 |
| Score 75 to 79 | B+ | 3.33 |
| Score 70 to 74 | B | 3.00 |
| Score 67 to 69 | B- | 2.67 |
| Score 64 to 66 | C+ | 2.33 |
| Score 60 to 63 | C | 2.00 |
| Score 55 to 59 | D | 1.00 |
| Score below 55 | E | 0.00 |

Score 67 to 69 | B- | 2.67 |
| Score 64 to 66 | C+ | 2.33 |
| Score 60 to 63 | C | 2.00 |
| Score 55 to 59 | D | 1.00 |
| Score below 55 | E | 0.00 |

**In plain text:**
- A grade (4.00): Score of 85 or higher
- A- grade (3.67): Score between 80 and 84
- B+ grade (3.33): Score between 75 and 79
- B grade (3.00): Score between 70 and 74
- B- grade (2.67): Score between 67 and 69
- C+ grade (2.33): Score between 64 and 66
- C grade (2.00): Score between 60 and 63
- D grade (1.00): Score between 55 and 59
- E grade (0.00): Score below 55 (failing grade)

**Key Information:**
- To get an A, you need a score of 85 or higher (4.00 GPA)
- Grade E (0.00 GPA) is a failing grade for scores below 55
- Minimum GPA to graduate is 2.00

### Grading Submission, Deadline, and Result
In every academic year, the Academic Bureau always sets deadline for grading submission. However, lecturers also have the discretion to input any score in their own convenient time so long as it does not exceed the scheduled deadline.

Based on **090/SKep-R/KMNM/XI/2019/Presuniv**, in the event that a certain lecturer fail to comply with the grading input deadline, Academic Bureau has the authority to give an A to all students enrolled in the subject in question.

## English Development Programs

President University provides services to help students who wish to develop their English proficiency through the following bodies:
* English Language and Literacy Center / ELLC (for free services - ellc@president.ac.id);
* President Development Center / PDC (service fee applicable - pdc@president.ac.id).

In addition, we offer an exclusive program to help new students adjust to the English-speaking environment through the **English 0 Credits Program** (applicable for Batch 2022 onwards). This program consists of 6 progressive levels, conducted every term from Semester 1 to Semester 6. The course titles for each level are as follows:
* **Level 1**: Survival English
* **Level 2**: Fluency and Speed Development
* **Level 3**: Accuracy Development
* **Level 4**: English for Professional Purposes
* **Level 5**: Academic Writing
* **Level 6**: Research Writing

## Internship

All final-year students in President University will be provided an opportunity to experience direct exposure to professional and business atmosphere through the Internship program in various companies/ institution of their own choosing. Students will firstly be required to find an Internship placement. During the recruitment process, some companies/ institutions might require students to provide Internship recommendation letter. Students are encouraged to access the link to fill out the required fields in the Internship recommendation letter.

Internship recommendation letter. Students are encouraged to access the link to fill out the required fields in the Internship recommendation letter.

While carrying out this program, students will be closely supervised by both their on-site supervisor and internally assigned Internship advisor. This assessment will become a part of the students grading component. In addition to this assessment, students will be required to submit monthly progress reports to ensure the supervision function throughout. At the end of the program, students will also be required to submit a final report and presenting this report to the internal internship advisor. The final report will be assessed and graded by the advisor directly in the system. Therefore, attaching a wet signature on the report will not be necessary. More detailed explanation may be found on the Internship guideline provided by the ICC.

## Kampus Berdampak

In compliance with the prevailing program offered by the government, President University attempts to accommodate students who might be interested to participate in one of the offered programs by assigning the Student Affairs Bureau to provide consultation services for students who wish to obtain more information on the program. Furthermore, students are also encouraged to consult with their own Academic Advisor and study program before participating in any of the Kampus Berdampak program as they are going to have to request for subject conversion after finishing the program for it to be legally recorded in their graduation transcript. Students who wish to obtain more information on Kampus Berdampak should contact Student Affairs Bureau (studentaffairs@president.ac.id).

## Students' Code of Conduct

Students should always behave themselves in a manner that is polite, respectful, and responsible, and which conforms to the generally accepted rules of behavior, customs, and traditions of Indonesia.

### Dress and Appearance

* President University expects students to be modest and decent in dress and appearance.
* The University desires students to come to class neat and tidy, wearing appropriate and decent clothing.
* Inappropriate decoration is not suitable as general garb for attending classes.
* A clean and neat appearance and maintenance of personal hygiene is required on campus.
* Slippers or sandals are not allowed.
* Dress, shirts and pants should be properly ironed.

Students who do not conform to these expectations may be prohibited from attending classes.

## Special Note for Medical Students

Medical students are required to take part in **two types of English programs** to ensure comprehensive language development:

1. **General and Academic English (Weekdays):**
   * Survival English
   * Speed and Fluency Development
   * Accuracy Development
   * Academic Writing

2. **MedLingua (Weekends):**
   * Basic Medical English
   * Intermediate Medical English
   * Advanced Medical English
   * Research Paper Writing/SLR
